summary: Modern, high-specification bathroom finished to an excellent standard throughout with marble-effect floor and feature tiling, white gloss sanitaryware, and a fitted mirrored cabinet with integrated lighting. The room is in very clean decorative condition with only minor domestic wear, including light limescale to the shower hose and shower screen seal strip.

items.name: Ceiling
items.description: Smooth emulsioned white ceiling with perimeter lighting channel.

items.name: Walls & Tiling
items.description: Combination finish: large-format light grey/off-white gloss rectangular ceramic tiling to bath and vanity elevations with fine grey grout joints; dark grey marble-effect (Pietra style) large-format porcelain tiling to lower wall runs, vanity return and WC elevation; emulsioned white plastered wall to entrance return adjacent the door with two brushed steel robe hooks
defects: Faint rub/scuff marks eye to high level right hand side of emulsioned wall adjacent ceiling line (P012)
Light surface dust film and slight darkening to horizontal grout joins mid level to tiled elevation (P019)
Water spotting/splash marks to tiled elevation surrounding bath valves chest level (P020)
Light shadow/rub marks to emulsion below and between robe hooks (P011)

items.name: Flooring
items.description: Large format dark marble-effect polished porcelain/ceramic floor tiles with white veining and light grey grout.

items.name: Entrance Door
items.description: Solid core white painted flush internal door fitted with matte black modern lever handle, matching thumbturn escutcheon, and floor-mounted doorstop.

items.name: Ceiling Lights & Cove Lighting
items.description: Recessed circular white LED downlights and concealed linear LED cove/strip lighting along ceiling channel.

items.name: Extractor Fan
items.description: White circular ceiling-mounted extractor air vent.

items.name: Wall Hooks
items.description: Pair of cylindrical brushed chrome/metal wall-mounted robe hooks.

items.name: Heated Towel Rail
items.description: Wall-mounted chrome/polished metal ladder-style heated towel radiator with square horizontal rungs.

items.name: Bathtub & Screen
items.description: White acrylic single-ended inset bath approx 1700mm, marble-effect tiled bath panel to front, with chrome pop-up waste and overflow; hinged clear toughened glass bath screen approx 800mm wide on black/gunmetal pivot hinges and brackets
defects: Soiling and discoloured sealant/debris build-up along full length of screen bottom track and bath rim join, low level (P017)
Chip/loss to plastic trim strip at top left hand side of bath panel edge, low level (P016)
Dust and grime to bath panel top trim and to join with floor tiling low level (P016)
Water marks and drip marks to bath interior base (P018)
Fingermarks/smears to glazing of bath screen to interior (P007, P008)

items.name: Shower & Bath Fittings
items.description: Zucchetti chrome concealed thermostatic bath/shower valve with twin round control handles to tiled elevation, chrome slide rail with adjustable bracket, multi-function chrome handshower head and flexible chrome shower hose; chrome bath overflow/filler and pop-up waste control
defects: Tarnishing and dark discolouration along full length of flexible shower hose (P021)
Light water spotting/limescale specking to chrome escutcheon plates of thermostatic valve chest level (P020)
Minor rub mark to chrome control handle left hand side (P020)
Light water marking to chrome handshower head and slide rail (P022)

items.name: Vanity Unit & Basin
items.description: Wall-hung white solid-surface (Corian-style) vanity top approx 1200mm with integrated rectangular basin and moulded shelf/ledge below, chrome wall-mounted mixer tap with separate lever handle and white pop-up waste, set against dark marble-effect tiled elevation
defects: Shade marks, smearing and dust film across white solid-surface top left hand side of basin (P024)
Light surface scuff/rub marks to leading edge of vanity top adjoining dark tiling (P025)
Dust and debris to join between vanity top and tiled wall (P025)
Water marks and drip marks to basin bowl and around waste (P026)
Light water spotting to chrome mixer tap (P026)

items.name: Mirrored Wall Cabinet
items.description: Multi-door wall-mounted mirrored cabinet with wood-effect laminate shelving, integrated vertical LED strip lights, illuminated magnifying mirror, shaver socket, and underfloor heating thermostat.

items.name: Toilet
items.description: Wall-hung white ceramic toilet pan with matching soft-close seat and lid, concealed cistern casing, and circular black dual flush button.

items.name: Toilet Roll Holder
items.description: Recessed polished chrome rectangular toilet roll holder niche.

items.name: Bath Mat
items.description: Black and white checkerboard plush bath mat.

items.name: Bathroom Scales
items.description: Square digital bathroom scale with frosted glass platform.

items.name: Waste Bin & Toilet Brush Set
items.description: Small stainless steel pedal bin and black freestanding toilet brush with canister holder.
